biotools.summary: kTYPr is an in silico tool designed to map the natural diversity of Escherichia coli transporter-dependent capsules (K-types). It uses an HMM-based approach to infer serotypes from whole genomic sequences, aiding in the study of E. coli ecology and pathogenicity.
